svg.aria-label: Coherence observed, and predicted from the cells' own periods
svg.text: Coherence observed, and predicted from the cells' own periods
svg.desc: 12 cells. period spread 0.244 h (95% CI 0.163 to 0.326). 101% of the fall explained. period divergence -- winding each cell on at the period it was measured to have reproduces the whole fall in coherence, and what is left over does not survive leaving one cell out.
